pins.title: A Long Weekend on Virginia's Northern Neck: 4-Day Itinerary
pins.description: A day-by-day itinerary for a long weekend on Virginia's Northern Neck: check in Thursday, crab pot at dawn, kayaks on the creek, Reedville on Saturday, checkout Sunday. Two hours forty five minutes from Washington DC.
pins.altText: Sunset over a tidal creek on Virginia's Northern Neck framed by oak branches, with the title 'A Long Weekend on Virginia's Northern Neck: 4-Day Itinerary.'
pins.keywordVariant: A Long Weekend on Virginia's Northern Neck: 4-Day Itinerary

pins.title: Waterfront Long Weekend: 2 Hours 45 Minutes from DC
pins.description: A waterfront long weekend two hours forty five minutes from Washington DC. A cedar sauna and a cold dip after dark, a crab pot at first light, kayaks on the creek, low boil on the porch. No bay bridge, no crowds.
pins.altText: A wooden dock reaching into a calm tidal creek on Virginia's Northern Neck in early morning light.
pins.keywordVariant: Waterfront Long Weekend: 2 Hours 45 Minutes from DC

pins.title: Crab Pull, Kayaks, Sauna: A Chesapeake Weekend Itinerary
pins.description: Crab pull at dawn, kayaks on a slow tidal creek, a cedar sauna after dark: a full itinerary for a Chesapeake weekend on Virginia's Northern Neck, two hours forty five minutes from Washington DC.
pins.altText: Split image: an oak-framed creek sunset above, a dock at dawn below, on Virginia's Northern Neck.
